complete_examples.text: This suggests that the straw ash is an effective mineral admixture in concrete when the replacement ratio is 10% (C20, C30).

For example, when the replacement ratio of straw ash exceeds 10% of the cement, steel bars were pulled out in all of the specimens and the rebar transverse ribs cut and ground all the contacting concrete surfaces, while splitting-pullout failure was the main damage in the specimen.
